question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Obstruct
solution:
The correct answer is "**Block.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Obstruct" means to block or hinder the progress or movement of something.**(बाधा डालती)

 
 
• Example: You should not obstruct the course of justice.
 
 
 
• **The word "block" means to obstruct or prevent movement or progress.**(अवरोध पैदा करना)
 
 
• Example: Some students today blocked a highway.
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, "block" is the closest synonym to "obstruct."

Hence,** the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "Separate," means to divide or set apart.(अलग)
 
• Option 3, "Magnify," means to make something appear larger or more important.(आवर्धक)
 
• Option 4, "Obey," means to follow or comply with a command or order.(आज्ञा का पालन करना)
